_comment_README: Drop the 'headers' array below into your repo's vercel.json. This REPLACES your current single Cache-Control rule with a split strategy: HTML never caches (so deploys are instant) and static assets cache hard. Plus security headers. The CSP is conservative — it allows the things your site already does (Supabase, Lemon Squeezy, Google Fonts, jsdelivr CDN, inline theme/scripts). If you load anything else, expand the allowlist or drop CSP and add it later.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdn.jsdelivr.net https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com https://plausible.io; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co wss://cxnotrikxvzncupswvio.supabase.co https://*.lemonsqueezy.com https://plausible.io; frame-src 'self' https://*.lemonsqueezy.com; frame-ancestors 'self'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests

_notes_after_paste: 1. frame-ancestors 'self' (not 'none') replaces X-Frame-Options while still allowing the in-app test harness: admin.html embeds tests.html, which embeds athlete.html?demo=1 — all same-origin. frame-src 'self' is needed for the same reason (admin embeds tests). 'self' still blocks all cross-origin framing, so clickjacking protection is intact.

2. The 'unsafe-inline' for script-src exists because index.html has inline theme script and inline onclick handlers (openSignupModal etc). Removing it would require refactoring those out into addEventListener. Acceptable for launch but worth a follow-up.
3. connect-src includes wss:// for Supabase realtime subscriptions — drop it if you don't use realtime.
4. If you add Plausible/PostHog/GA, you'll need to extend script-src and connect-src.
5. Test after deploying: open devtools console on every page and check for CSP violation errors. Common breaks: external images, embedded YouTube, Stripe Elements. Adjust allowlist accordingly.
6. Verify HSTS only AFTER you're certain you'll stay on HTTPS — once preloaded, hard to undo.
